subject.title: fix(release): unblock Meta npm bootstrap publication

question: Should the protected release workflow accept this one-time, Meta-only npm token bootstrap before the package's GitHub trusted publisher is configured?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but approving a new credential-bearing exception in protected release automation is an explicit security-boundary choice that should remain human-owned.

options.title: Approve the narrow bootstrap exception
options.body: Allow this exact verified Meta beta tarball to publish with the protected registry token, then require trusted-publisher configuration before the next release.

options.title: Keep publication blocked
options.body: Do not add the token route and postpone the Meta beta until npm trusted publishing can be configured through another bootstrap process.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow bootstrap exception
recommendation.body: Allow this exact verified Meta beta tarball to publish with the protected registry token, then require trusted-publisher configuration before the next release.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the relevant immutable evidence patterns, own the paired issue and PR, and have the strongest recent history in this release boundary.
